tasks.title: Design the bounded rank-31 search and certificate protocol

handoff.objective: Convert the carried-forward GOAL-ECQ-001 criterion-C1 next action into a frozen, falsifiable first-batch protocol for GOAL-ECQ-bef741: enumerate and replay the exact 66 archived timeout cases, extend the prior Mestre scan by exactly 32 deterministically selected frontier cells, define four shape-matched controls, and connect any resulting candidate to an unconditional exact rank-31 certificate path.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the inherited timeout and Mestre-scan direction can be specified as a bounded, reproducible, controlled experiment whose outputs can progress toward an exact rank-at-least-31 proof without treating infrastructure failures, floating regulators, or point counts as mathematical evidence.
inputs: The immutable experiments and run records cited by GOAL-ECQ-001 for its 66 carried-forward timeouts and prior Mestre scan.
constraints: This task permits one agent invocation and zero mathematical searches, curve-generation runs, benchmarks, timeout replays, Mestre cells, candidate screens, rank computations, or other experiments.
Read the authoritative archived records. Do not reconstruct the 66 cases from recollection, prose summaries, uncommitted files, or mutable state.

Enumerate exactly 66 unique timeout cases by source experiment or run ID, parameters, seed, exact command, source commit, environment, original timeout ceiling, and observed termination. If the immutable inventory is not exactly 66 unique cases, report the discrepancy and stop without inventing, duplicating, or silently dropping a case.

Define a deterministic rule that selects exactly 32 previously untested Mestre frontier cells from the archived grid and publish the resulting ordered 32-tuple list before execution. The rule may not depend on a new result.
Define exactly four controls: two immutable successful-cell replays and two same-shape null controls. Controls must use the same measurement path.
Provide mechanisms, predictions, metrics, test boundaries, falsification criteria, per-run and aggregate budgets, stopping rules, required artifacts, and infrastructure-failure classifications.
Include a proof_search_map covering exact-baseline reproduction, observation-collision search, quantifier order, method ceiling, and a nearby-object control.

Specify how a promising candidate will yield an exact curve, exact rational points, exact on-curve checks, a justified exact F2 character matrix or equivalent unconditional independence certificate, and torsion treatment.
Treat numerical regulators and analytic-rank estimates only as candidate ranking signals. They may not support a rank lower-bound claim.
Give every citation provenance as recalled, retrieved, kb, or internal. Recalled references are pointers only and may not support a decision.
Include Pareto accounting across time, memory, and data or query cost, with dominated_by and a quantitative sota_delta. Do not use an unchecked null.
Do not create executable handoffs, mutate the dispatch queue, change any goal or hypothesis status, or claim that rank greater than 30 was achieved.
deliverables: A protocol artifact containing an immutable manifest of exactly 66 unique timeout cases or an explicit inventory discrepancy that blocks approval.
A deterministic selection rule and ordered list of exactly 32 new Mestre cells.

A complete experiment specification with controls, metrics, budgets, stopping rules, artifacts, failure classifications, proof_search_map, exact certificate route, Pareto and SOTA assessment, and citation provenance.
A truthful task report recording zero mathematical experiments.
